CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting - Conference Room A
  Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. 1st St., Alhambra, CA 91801

June 13, 2023

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

B.  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Nora Hernandez, Michael Daninger, Stanley Tsai
  Absent: Ankit Udani
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

C.  CONSENT AGENDA

  All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design
  Review Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the
  Discussion Agenda.

  ITEM 1: DRB MINUTES - May 23, 2023

  ITEM 2: 39 South Garfield Avenue

  ITEM 3: 855 West Valley Boulevard

  Item 2 is pulled to the Discussion Items by Michael Daninger

  MOTION:
  o Daninger moved to approve Items 1 and 3.
  o The second was by Tsai.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  ITEM 2: 39 South Garfield Avenue

  •  Request: New wall signage for a business known as “PROJECT CCG” for an existing
  commercial building.

  1
   •  Applicant: Eddie Vinciquera, Gan Signs & Graphic, Inc.

  •  Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

  •  Discussion:
  The applicant was present. The staff report was given.

  Board Member Daninger stated that there were no defining dimensions on the
  drawings to accurately place the sign on the sign band. The applicant stated that he
  understood and will update the drawings and resubmit said drawings to DRB staff.

  Board Member Hernandez stated that could be conditioned with the approval.

MOTION:

  o Board Member Daninger moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The drawings shall be updated with the necessary dimensions of
  the sign band; and 2) The drawings shall be reviewed by DRB staff prior to
  building permit submittal.
  o The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani

ITEM 4: 211 South Cordova Street

  •  Request: A new addition and exterior alterations to an existing single-family
  residence.

  •  Applicant: Nathan and Ramon Gallardo

  •  Recommended Action: Recommendation is for continuance to allow for redesign
  of the new proposed materials.

  •  Discussion:
  The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

  The applicant stated that he was willing to revise the design.

  Bert Ng was present and lives at 203 South Cordova Street. He stated that the subject
  property stuck out due to its lack of authentic style. He stated that the home was
  originally built in a craftsman style and should be remodeled in a craftsman style. He
  cited several neighbors that attest to the craftsman origins of the home. He also cited
  the Alhambra Design Guidelines and stated that his request is based on the R1
  guidelines.

  2
   Jennifer Ng also spoke and showed images of the previous design. She stated that
  the windows were out of place and although the house is bereft of most of the original
  craftsman details it should still be remodeled in the craftsman style. Because it is one
  of the larger homes it would benefit from a restoration to its original style.

  Bruce Risher is the curator of the Alhambra Historical Museum. He stated that the
  original house was a craftsman with a shake exterior. He stated that the neighborhood
  is replete with craftsman homes and was disappointed when that house changed from
  shake to stucco. He also disagreed with the comment that the house could be non-
  craftsman in style. He stated that due to the neighborhood context if the house is to
  be remodeled that it should be done in a craftsman style.

  Board Member Tsai stated that the proposed design has a character that is more
  commercial than residential given the 1 ½” reveal lines. He agreed that the style is
  out of context with the rest of the street. The metal porch reinforced the anomalies.

  Board Member Daninger stated that the design was out of place. Since the proposal
  includes changing windows they could use a style more keeping with the area.

  Board Member Hernandez stated that she personally prefers modern styled homes
  but this neighborhood is not suited for a modern style. She stated further that even if
  this proposed style was considered, this iteration is not a good example of that style.
  The relief of the stucco and the use of veneer is not appropriate and agreed with
  Board Member Tsai that the aesthetic leans toward a commercial appearance.

  City Architect Abe elaborated on the staff comments. Given the nature of the
  massing, the roof configuration and the current fenestration it was difficult to discern
  that the house was originally craftsman. The comment of appropriateness of
  remodeling the home in a non-craftsman style was based on the current existing
  condition of the house. It was helpful to understand the history of the subject home
  and given the unusual nature of the street (being that the street is one of only a few
  streets in Alhambra that have a large number of authentic craftsman homes) the
  applicant should seriously consider the comments made during the review.

  The applicant stated their history of living in Alhambra and that they are earnest in
  their desire to provide a reasonable design. They further stated that the Board
  comments are helpful and that they would speak to the owner.

  City Architect Abe stated that his tenure of consultation was limited but was available
  through June.

MOTION:

  o Board Member Daninger moved for continuance.
  o The second was by Board Member Tsai.

  3
   o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani

  ITEM 5: 317 North First Street

  •  Request: A new multi-family residential development.

  •  Applicant: Eric Tsang

  •  Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that
  MWELO- compliant documents be provided prior to building plan check submittal.

  •  Discussion:
  Board Member Tsai questioned the location of the open space. He was also
  concerned with the visibility of the AC roof mounted units and stated that rooftop
  screening may be necessary.

  Board Member Hernandez stated that there is common open space at the rear but
  Board Member Tsai questioned the location and allocation of private open space. He
  further recognized that the private open space for unit 319B was limited to just the
  entry area.

  Discussion ensued and it was confirmed that the project meets the requirement for
  open space. It was stated that the planning commission concern was the use of the
  rooftop rails. The applicant stated that due to the location of the property the best
  solution was to eliminate the rooftop open space. Due to the reduced need for the
  guest spaces there was a redesign of the open space.

  MOTION:

  o Board Member Tsai moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The rooftop AC equipment shall be screened to comply with any
  necessary code; and 2) Any necessary MWELO documentation documents be
  provided prior to building plan check submittal.
  o The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani

E.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  We will adjourn to the next meeting on June 27, 2023.

  4
   MOTION:

  o Board Member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:30 P.M.
  o The second was by Board Member Tsai
  o The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani

  Ankit Udani
  Chairman
